name: RTI ask: station-wise monthly FIR counts by crime head
publisher: State DGP office / State Crime Records Bureau
how_to_obtain: File the draft application at section 5(a) of the dossier with the State DGP/SCRB. Frame as a copy of an existing CCTNS monthly crime review output, not as a new compilation, to pre-empt s.7(9).

name: RTI ask: police station jurisdiction boundaries
how_to_obtain: Item 3 of draft 5(b). Ask for whatever form it is held in - textual boundary description, village or ward list, revenue circle codes, or a map. A shapefile is unlikely; a village list is tractable and joins to LGD codes.
caveats: no state is known to publish these
this single item is what separates a district choropleth from a police.uk-style product

publisher: State Legislative Assemblies / Parliament of India
how_to_obtain: Requires an MP or MLA willing to table the question. No fee, no 30-day wait, no appeal, and answers are tabled publicly with annexures. The MHA dossier found Rajya Sabha answers already published as CSV on data.gov.in.
caveats: depends on a cooperative legislator
